neighbours.label: ' specially' (and Russian специальн-) for something made, chosen or prepared for a particular purpose ('specially designed', 'specially selected', 'specially trained'); the same sentences with 'carefully', 'well' or 'ordinary' stay quiet.
fire: The seeds are coated with a specially formulated gel.
Guests stayed in a specially built cabin by the lake.
The astronauts used specially designed gloves.
Our bakers use specially milled flour for this bread.
The paintings are stored in specially sealed cases.
Rescue teams brought specially trained dogs.
The menu was specially prepared for the wedding.
quiet: The seeds are coated with a thin layer of gel.
Guests stayed in a small cabin by the lake.
The astronauts used thick white gloves.
Our bakers use stone-ground flour for this bread.
The paintings are stored in large wooden cases.
The menu was printed for the wedding.

notes: Card: ' specially' x8, ' special' x6, ' right' x4, Russian -альные/-альной (специальных) x5, ' certain' x3. Exploratory probe: 'specially selected steel' 0.85, 'specially trained' 0.36, 'specific credentials' 0.15; 'well trained' 0.04, 'ordinary steel' 0.02.
